svg.title: Behind the '4.5 times the ED risk' figure: absolute rates
svg.desc: Behind the '4.5 times the ED risk' figure: absolute rates. ED diagnosis or ED-pill prescription: semaglutide 1.47%, matched non-users 0.32%. Testosterone deficiency diagnosis: semaglutide 1.53%, matched non-users 0.8%.
